summary: Resets a collision broadphase bucket state block at a fixed global address: stores a type tag of 74 into the first word and zeroes five following bucket-state words. Always executes unconditionally and returns 0.

operations.description: Store the bucket type tag 74 into the first word of the broadphase bucket block.
Zero the second bucket state word.
Zero the third bucket state word.
Zero the fourth bucket state word.
Zero the fifth bucket state word.
Zero the sixth bucket state word.

unresolved: Identity and layout of the object owning the six-word block starting at 0x7CD098.
Semantic meaning of the type tag 74 and of each of the five zeroed bucket-state words.
